This petition has been filed for quashing of order dated 05.11.2018 passed in G.R. No.5812 of 2017 arising out of Abadpur P.S. Case No.201 of 2017 whereby and whereunder learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge, Katihar refused to discharge the petitioners from the offence under Sections 363,
366(a), 376, 504/34 of I.P.C. and Section 4 of POCSO Act.
2. From the status report, it appears that the said case has already been disposed of.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this case may be disposed of as it has become infructuous.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.80683 of 2018(2) dt.31-01-2026 4.
Learned APP for the State has no objection to this prayer of the petitioners.
